item.title: On nearly Lefschetz fibrations and spinal open books
item.description: arXiv:2611.04089v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We survey the recent development of spinal open books and nearly Lefschetz fibrations. The focus is on explaining past and new results regarding the detection of symplectic fillability and classification of symplectic fillings of contact 3-manifolds in light of the new machinery. We give many examples and a list of open questions. This can be considered as an additional chapter to the lecture notes by Ozbacgi and Wendl.
item.dc:creator: Hyunki Min, Agniva Roy, Luya Wang

item.title: Categorical and Floer-theoretic entropies: comparison and counting conjugacy classes in symplectic mapping class groups
item.description: arXiv:2611.04161v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Let $W$ be a Weinstein manifold and let $f: W \to W$ be a compactly supported symplectic automorphism. Using Floer theories, one can define two different entropies of $f$, called "Floer-theoretic" entropy and "categorical" entropy. The current article compares these two entropies and show that the former bounds the latter from below. As an application of the comparison, using that these entropies are invariants up to the conjugate relation, we count conjugacy classes in symplectic mapping classes. Especially, we show an exponential abundance of conjugacy classes that are smoothly isotopic to the identity, when $W$ is a Weinstein manifold of dimension $4n \geq 6$, satisfying a local condition.
item.dc:creator: Sangjin Lee

item.title: Mapping-space Gromov--Witten classes and the Fano variety of lines
item.description: arXiv:2611.05324v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Let $Y$ be a smooth cubic 3-fold. We show that $S^2 \times Y$ admits an infinite sequence of cohomologous symplectic forms which are all deformation equivalent but pairwise non-isotopic; McDuff showed the corresponding result on $(S^2)^2 \times T^2$, but these appear to be the first simply-connected and monotone examples. The results are obtained from McDuff's bordism-flavoured Gromov--Witten invariant, re-interpreted cohomologically in terms of an evaluation map valued in the space of maps from the 2-sphere to a symplectic target. The application then relies on classical properties of the Fano space of lines on $Y$. We also discuss higher-dimensional generalisations.
item.dc:creator: Ivan Smith, Abigail Ward

item.title: Convex ribbon disks, quasipositivity, and Lagrangian sliceness
item.description: arXiv:2611.05331v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We introduce a version of convex surface theory for immersed ribbon surfaces with Legendrian boundary. As an application, we establish a special case of K3: Problem 1.70 on sharpness in the slice-Bennequin inequality implying quasipositivity, and a special case of a conjecture of Cornwell, Ng, and Sivek on characterizing Lagrangian sliceness. Specifically, we prove that if $K$ is a knot that bounds a "star-shaped" ribbon disk and satisfies $\overline{\mathrm{sl}}(K) = -1$ (resp.\ $\overline{\mathrm{tb}}(K) = -1$), then $K$ is quasipositive (resp.\ Lagrangian slice). In fact, we prove these statements for any fixed transverse (resp.\ Legendrian) representative.
item.dc:creator: Joseph Breen, Alexander Zupan

item.title: Multiplicity Bounds for Contractible Closed Reeb Orbits on Prequantization Bundles
item.description: arXiv:2610.24557v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We study the multiplicity of contractible closed Reeb orbits on prequantization circle bundles $(M^{2n+1},\xi)$ over closed symplectic manifolds $(B^{2n},\omega)$. For even $n$, under suitable geometric hypotheses, we prove that every non-degenerate contact form supporting $\xi$ whose contractible closed orbits have nonzero mean index and whose good contractible closed orbits have nonzero Conley--Zehnder index carries at least $\frac{1}{2}\chi(B)+\frac{1}{2}\dim H_n(B;\mathbb{Q})+1$ geometrically distinct contractible closed Reeb orbits. In dimension five, under the corresponding geometric hypotheses and assuming $H_1(B;\mathbb{Q})=0$, we prove the conjectural lower bound $\dim H_*(B;\mathbb{Q})$ for every non-degenerate supporting contact form whose simple contractible closed orbits have nonzero Conley--Zehnder index.
item.dc:creator: Peng Liu

item.title: On the Dynamics of Invariant Graphs for Dissipative Twist Maps
item.description: arXiv:2506.04938v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We study the persistence and internal dynamics of invariant graphs for dissipative twist maps. Explicit $C^1$ persistence and parameter estimates allow every real rotation number to be realized by varying either translation parameter, while arbitrarily small zero-mean analytic perturbations at fixed irrational horizontal parameters can yield analytic graphs with dynamics conjugate to rational rotations. With a fixed Brjuno horizontal parameter and fixed-strip analyticity, normally attracting $C^r$ graphs persist under perturbations of size $(1-\lambda)^\gamma$, for any $\gamma>0$ and prescribed finite $r$, as $\lambda\to1^-$. At the critical Lipschitz bound, the invariant graphs can carry Denjoy dynamics and have countably many nondifferentiable points, with perturbations smooth outside a null Cantor set and tending to zero in every H\"older norm of order less than one.
item.dc:creator: Qi Li, Lin Wang
